name: AI Assistant
description: Talk to your home in plain language — by text, voice or Telegram. A pluggable AI brain (Claude, ChatGPT or a local Ollama) reads your entities and calls the right services: 'turn off all lights', 'set the bedroom lamp to 50% red', 'is the front door locked?'. Push-to-talk and a 'Hey …' wake word in the browser, spoken replies, and a safety layer that can require a confirmation or a PIN before doors, locks or the alarm are touched.
